name: expo-orbit
title: Expo Orbit
description: Launch simulators and emulators, pair Android devices, and open builds, updates, and Snacks with Expo Orbit, which must be installed.
author: michalzuch

commands.name: manage-devices
commands.title: Manage Devices
commands.subtitle: Expo Orbit
commands.description: See your simulators, emulators, and connected devices, then launch, stop, or open builds on them.

commands.name: launch-build
commands.title: Launch Build or Update
commands.subtitle: Expo Orbit
commands.description: Install and launch an EAS build, an app file, an EAS Update, or a Snack on a simulator, emulator, or device.

commands.name: pair-android-device
commands.title: Pair Android Device
commands.subtitle: Expo Orbit
commands.description: Connect a physical Android device over Wi-Fi with a pairing code or a QR code.

preferences.name: emulatorWithoutAudio
preferences.title: Android Emulators
preferences.label: Launch without audio
preferences.description: Start Android emulators with their audio turned off.

preferences.name: androidSdkPath
preferences.title: Android SDK Location
preferences.description: The folder of your Android SDK. Leave empty to use $ANDROID_HOME or Expo Orbit's setting.

preferences.name: trustedSources
preferences.title: Trusted Sources
preferences.description: Extra sources for builds and updates, separated by commas. Expo Orbit trusts expo.dev by default. These are added to Expo Orbit's trusted sources.

preferences.name: showIos
preferences.title: Platforms
preferences.label: iOS
preferences.description: Show iOS simulators and connected iPhones and iPads.

preferences.name: showAndroid
preferences.label: Android
preferences.description: Show Android emulators and connected Android devices.

tools.name: get-devices
tools.title: Get Devices
tools.description: List the iOS simulators, Android emulators, and connected devices Expo Orbit can use, and whether each one is running.

tools.name: launch-device
tools.title: Launch Device
tools.description: Boot a simulator or emulator, or bring its window to the front if it's already running.

tools.name: stop-device
tools.title: Stop Device
tools.description: Shut down a running simulator or emulator, after you confirm.

tools.name: open-on-device
tools.title: Open on Device
tools.description: Install and launch an EAS build or app file, open an EAS Update, or open a Snack in Expo Go on a device, after you confirm.
